title: Baby Kangaroos Are Jelly Bean Size!

beats.say: You were a tiny baby once. A baby kangaroo is as small as a jelly bean! Where does it live?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's hop to the kangaroos!
A baby kangaroo is called a joey. It lives in its mom's pouch.
It stays safe and warm in there, and grows big and strong.
Then one day, it's ready to hop out!
Can you hop like a kangaroo? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!
You sleep at night. A lion can sleep up to twenty hours a day! Why so long?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's tiptoe to the lions. Shh!
Lions live together in family groups called prides.
Lots of napping helps them save their energy.
And when they wake up, you can hear their roar from five miles away!
Can you do a tiny roar? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!
You have one heart. An octopus has three! And guess what color its blood is?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's dive down to the octopus!
Its blood is blue!
An octopus can change its color to hide. Watch!
It has no bones, so it can squeeze through tiny spaces.
Can you wiggle like an octopus? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!
You can move your eyes left and right. An owl can't! So how does it look around?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's fly to the owls! Hoo, hoo!
An owl turns its whole head instead!
It can turn its head almost all the way around.
Owl feathers are so soft, owls fly very quietly.
Can you be quiet like an owl? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!
You were a baby once. A baby panda is pink, and as small as a stick of butter! Can you believe it?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's visit the giant pandas!
Pandas turn black and white as they grow up.
They eat bamboo for about half of the day!
A special bump on their wrist helps them hold the bamboo.
Can you munch like a panda? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!
You move fast. A sloth moves so slowly, tiny green plants grow on its fur! Why?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's go see the sloths. Slowly!
Sloths hang upside down in the trees.
Tiny plants called algae grow on their fur.
The green helps them hide in the leaves!
Can you move slowly like a sloth? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!

title: No Two Zebras Are the Same!

beats.say: You have your own fingerprints. Every zebra has its own stripes! Can you spot the difference?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's gallop to the zebras!
No two zebras have the same stripes.
Under the fur, zebra skin is dark!
A baby zebra learns its mom's stripes, so it can always find her.
Can you gallop like a zebra? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!
You wear sunscreen at the beach. A hippo makes its own! How does it work?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's splash over to the hippos!
A hippo's skin makes a special red-orange goo.
It helps protect the hippo from the hot sun.
And hippos can't really swim. They walk on the river bottom!
Can you open your mouth wide like a hippo? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!
You eat food to grow. A flamingo's food makes it pink! Can you guess which food?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's fly to the flamingos!
Tiny shrimp and plants called algae!
Baby flamingos are gray or white at first.
They turn pink as they grow up.
Can you stand on one leg like a flamingo? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!
You can see your skin. A polar bear's skin is black, under all that white fur! Surprised?
Hi! I'm Milo. Brr! Let's visit the polar bears!
Polar bear fur looks white, but the skin underneath is black.
Thick fat keeps them warm, like a cozy blanket.
And they are amazing swimmers in icy water.
Can you stomp like a polar bear? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!

title: Sea Turtles Can't Hide in Their Shells!

beats.say: You can hide under a blanket. A sea turtle can't hide its head in its shell! Why not?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's swim to the sea turtles!
Sea turtle heads don't fit inside their shells.
So they use their big flippers to swim away fast.
Baby sea turtles hatch on the beach, and crawl to the ocean.
Can you paddle like a sea turtle? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!

title: Spider Monkeys Hang by Their Tails!

beats.say: You have two hands. A spider monkey has an extra one: its tail! How does it work?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's swing over to the spider monkeys!
Its tail can hold on to a branch, just like a hand.
So it can hang and swing through the trees.
Spider monkeys love to eat fruit.
Can you swing your arms like a monkey? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!
You have fingerprints on your fingers. A koala has them too! Can you find yours?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's climb up to the koalas!
Koala fingerprints look a lot like ours.
Koalas hug trees and eat eucalyptus leaves.
And they sleep up to twenty hours a day!
Can you give a tree hug like a koala? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!
